jobs.objective: REVISE the v3 RFC 0165 SPEC (the daemon-brokered access-token projection for Claude lanes; #583) to discharge the three v3 binding constraints C1/C2/C3, carrying forward UNREGRESSED everything v1+v3 cleared. Start from the v3 HOLDER.md (required context — do NOT rewrite from scratch); the v3 cycle-1 ledger (required context) gives the exact prescribed fixes. RFC 0165 stays CLAUDE-SPECIFIC: RFC 0169 is the separate provider-agnostic spine; note the seam (0169 defines the cross-provider readiness contract; 0165 v4 hardens the Claude assurance class / daemon-broker custody) but keep v4 standing on its own. DISCHARGE C1 (daemon-owned state is the ONLY positive freshness authority in recovery): v3's recovery freshness check was not race-free/positively-daemon-owned — a stale daemon row could be upgraded to ready, or a missing/inconsistent row inferred green. FIX: a stale / missing / internally inconsistent `provider_auth_dependencies` (or broker) row must fail CLOSED to a typed reseed-required classification — never a generic MCP-discovery retry, never a green/ready inference; specify the race-free read (the daemon row is authoritative, the lane-side file/socket is never the freshness oracle). DISCHARGE C2 (explicit same-user decision): v3's F2 proof only holds for a distinct-UID lane; under `config.RunAsUser == ""` (or a value resolving to the daemon/operator identity) the lane shares the operator's home and can read the raw credential. FIX (preferred): fail CLOSED when `RunAsUser` is empty or resolves to the daemon/operator identity, with a typed launch-precondition error — no silent same-user credential sharing. DISCHARGE C3 (no raw refresh-token custody by ANY route): even via the same-user shape the lane must never reach the rotating refresh token. FIX: either declare Claude OAuth same-user self-driving lanes UNSUPPORTED and fail closed, OR have the daemon broker mint/serve only short-lived access (the v3 B1 0600-file / B2 SO_PEERCRED projection that carries NO refresh token), with refresh authority held in exactly one place. Add the required tests: a SAME-USER fixture for the no-refresh-token assertion that scans EVERY lane-readable credential surface named by the launch environment (not only the newly written projection file); the C1 fail-closed recovery test (stale/missing/inconsistent row → reseed-required, never green); the C2 same-user typed-precondition refusal test. CARRY FORWARD UNREGRESSED: the access-token-only projector in laneproviderauth, path/ownership rules, the spawn-time projection gate (placement unchanged), the runtime-expiry circuit breaker (F1) + decay signal, the durable-state/receipts model (access token never persisted), the redaction contract, the RFC 0096 trust boundary, `refresh_token_absent`. Open the revised SPEC with an auditable 'Addressing the v3 constraints' map (C1/C2/C3 RESOLVED how; carry-forwards INTACT). Keep local-first (no hosted services; no raw OAuth material in DB rows, repo artifacts, metrics, events, or doctor output). This is the published claim the falsifiers re-attack.
jobs.title: Hold leading proposal

jobs.objective: Read the published REVISED (v4) holder SPEC, the v3 HOLDER.md, and the v3 cycle-1 ledger (its C1/C2 findings). Your lens is C1 (daemon-owned freshness authority in recovery) + C2 (same-user decision). FIRST verify C1 is GENUINELY resolved: in the recovery/requeue path, is daemon-owned state the ONLY positive freshness authority — can a stale, missing, or internally inconsistent `provider_auth_dependencies`/broker row EVER be upgraded to ready or inferred green by any route (a race where the lane writes a future-dated value with no refresh token; a lane-side file/socket read substituting for the daemon row)? Does a stale/missing/inconsistent row fail CLOSED to a typed reseed-required classification (NOT a generic MCP-discovery retry)? Construct the race. THEN verify C2: under `config.RunAsUser == ""` or a value resolving to the daemon/operator identity, does the spec fail CLOSED with a typed launch-precondition error, or can a same-user lane still silently share the operator credential? Is the refusal at the right gate (before any Claude process starts)? If recovery can still infer freshness from non-daemon state, if a stale row can go green, or if the same-user shape is not fail-closed, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.
jobs.title: Falsifier 1

jobs.objective: Read the published REVISED (v4) holder SPEC, the v3 HOLDER.md, and the v3 cycle-1 ledger (its C3 finding). Your lens is C3 (no raw refresh-token custody by ANY route) + CARRY-FORWARD REGRESSION. FIRST verify C3 is GENUINELY resolved: can a Claude lane obtain the rotating refresh token by ANY route — the distinct-UID projection, the same-user shape, a lane-readable file named by the launch environment, an env var, an inherited fd, a fallback path? The fix must be either same-user-unsupported-fail-closed OR a daemon broker that mints/serves ONLY short-lived access (the projection carries NO refresh token; refresh authority in exactly one place). Is the same-user no-refresh-token test real — does it scan EVERY lane-readable credential surface named by the launch environment, not just the newly written projection file? THEN spend the rest on REGRESSION: verify each carry-forward survives unregressed — the access-token-only projector, path/ownership rules, the spawn-time projection gate (placement unchanged), the F1 runtime-expiry circuit breaker + decay signal, the durable-state/receipts model (access token never persisted), the redaction contract (no raw OAuth material in DB/repo/metrics/events/doctor), the RFC 0096 trust boundary, `refresh_token_absent`. Confirm the C1/C2 changes did not perturb these. If the refresh token is reachable by any route, the credential-surface scan is incomplete, or any carry-forward regressed, say so explicitly and stop the gate from clearing.
jobs.title: Falsifier 2

jobs.objective: Read only the dialogue trajectory for the RFC 0165 v4 REVISION (the revised HOLDER.md and the two FALSIFIER.md challenges), with the v3 HOLDER.md and the v3 cycle-1 ledger (its C1/C2/C3 findings) as context for what the revision had to fix. Publish the collaboration ledger verdict (one of accept, accept_with_findings, needs_revision, reject — a clearing verdict is accept or accept_with_findings, never `clear`). A clearing verdict REQUIRES ALL THREE genuinely discharged: C1 — daemon-owned state is the only positive freshness authority in recovery; a stale/missing/inconsistent row fails CLOSED to reseed-required (never green, never generic retry), race-free; C2 — same-user Claude OAuth lanes (`RunAsUser` empty or daemon/operator identity) fail CLOSED with a typed launch-precondition error; C3 — the rotating refresh token is unreachable by the lane by ANY route (same-user-unsupported OR a no-refresh-token daemon broker), proven by a same-user test scanning EVERY lane-readable credential surface; AND no carry-forward regressed (access-token-only projector, path/ownership, spawn-time gate, F1 circuit breaker + decay, durable-state/receipts with access token never persisted, redaction contract, RFC 0096 boundary, refresh_token_absent); AND no new material challenge stands. Record per constraint C1/C2/C3 whether RESOLVED, per carry-forward whether INTACT, per new challenge whether it stands. needs_revision if any of C1/C2/C3 remains open, a carry-forward regressed, or a new material challenge lands. This is the single allowed v4 revision cycle; a second needs_revision ends the gate uncleared and routes to the operator (a fresh -v5 run with a revising holder).
jobs.title: Adjudicate dialogue substance

jobs.objective: Publish the cleared, revised falsifiable implementation SPEC for RFC 0165 (Claude provider-credential freshness; #583) — ONLY after the adjudicator ledger records a clearing verdict — incorporating C1/C2/C3 and every preserved finding without weakening any constraint. This SPEC is the artifact the rfc-0165-build code_change run consumes, so it must be buildable contract-first and consolidate the WHOLE Claude assurance design (not just the deltas): the access-token-only daemon-broker projection (no refresh token to the lane), the fail-closed recovery freshness classification (daemon-owned state authoritative; stale/missing/inconsistent → reseed-required), the same-user fail-closed launch precondition, the spawn-time projection gate, the F1 runtime-expiry circuit breaker + decay signal, the durable-state/receipts model (access token never persisted), the redaction contract, and ALL named tests (the same-user no-refresh-token credential-surface scan; the C1 stale/missing/inconsistent → reseed-required test; the C2 same-user typed-precondition refusal). State each as a falsifiable assertion + its test. Note the seam to RFC 0169 (the provider-agnostic spine) so the Claude adapter plugs into 0169's contract. Reference the clearing ledger. This consolidated SPEC is the single source the build run implements.
